description: Where a TmChart funnel stage's label is drawn. The stage bands narrow with the value, so a label that fits a wide first stage does not fit a thin last one.

members.name: Auto
members.description: Inside the stage when its band is at least 150 viewBox units wide, beside the funnel otherwise. The default, so a funnel that never sets FunnelLabelPlacement renders exactly what it rendered before the placement existed.

members.name: Inside
members.description: Always inside the stage band, centered. A thin stage keeps its label centered over the band instead of moving it out of the shape.

members.name: Outside
members.description: Always beside the stage, in one COLUMN in the gutter to the right of the funnel: the funnel narrows to 62 % of the plot width and starts at its left edge, so every label reads at the same x and never sits on a fill colour. The gutter is sized from the longest stage label and value line; a name longer than it can hold is truncated with an ellipsis and its full text moves into the label's tooltip.
